query: INSERT INTO invites (invite_id, vault_id, inviter, role, expires, state, invitee, accept) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT (invite_id) DO UPDATE SET vault_id = excluded.vault_id, inviter = excluded.inviter, role = excluded.role, expires = excluded.expires, state = excluded.state, invitee = excluded.invitee, accept = excluded.accept
